item_short_desc: Rothco's U.S. Flag Bandana combines style, comfort, and functionality with its iconic American flag design. Made from 100% durable cotton, this bandana is perfect for a variety of uses, from wearing under a helmet to protecting your face from dust or keeping your neck warm in chilly weather. Available in 2 convenient sizes, 22 inch x 22 inch and 27 inch x 27 inch, it offers a comfortable fit for multiple purposes, including as a handkerchief, facemask, or washcloth.
